title: Late Refund Posting Goodwill — Calculation (Harborline Customer Accounts)
content:
> Harborline Customer Accounts

**What is measured.** The schedule reads the customer's most recent domain refund line returned to account credit, where no other domain refund line returned to account credit shares its date, whenever the account's refund credit entry for the refunded charge's order number is dated more than 3 calendar days after the refund line; a refund posted within that time, or a latest date shared by two such refund lines, is outside this schedule. The refund line points to the charge it refunded, and that charge's order number is the reference the refund credit entry on the account's credit ledger carries.

**Calculation.**

1. The days the posting lagged are the calendar days from the refund line's date to the date of the account's refund credit entry for the refunded charge's order number.
2. The late-posting goodwill figure is 0.2 (20 percent) of the refund credit posted for that order number.
3. For a grant under this schedule the yearly goodwill total is the sum of the goodwill entries dated after the same calendar date one year before today, a grant may not exceed the tier's per-case goodwill limit nor bring that yearly goodwill total above the tier's yearly goodwill limit, and a grant beyond either limit is made only up to the remaining limit; a goodwill grant made under none of Harborline's published service-failure goodwill schedules (late hosting provisioning, late recovery review decisions, same-day duplicate domain auto-renew charges, late certificate issuance, late recovery resets and late refund postings) remains under the base limit sentence.
4. The late-posting goodwill granted is the late-posting goodwill figure limited in that way and rounded half up to the cent once, at the end; where the limited amount is zero, nothing is owed under this schedule and no entry is posted.
5. In working the figure through to the amount granted, the fixed uplifts that apply are added to the late-posting goodwill figure, the limits are then applied, and only the final figure is rounded half up to the cent.

The per-case and yearly limits are those of the account's tier in the goodwill limits by tier.

**Hypothetical example.** A domain refund line returned to account credit is dated 2 August; the refund credit entry of $27.35 for the refunded charge's order number is dated 9 August, 7 days later, more than 3. Figure: 20 percent of $27.35, $5.47. On a Harborline Reseller Bronze account with $97.10 of goodwill dated after the same calendar date one year before today, the yearly room is $2.90, so $2.90 is granted.

**Boundary.** Refund credit entry 3 days after the refund line: outside. 4 days after: inside.
